summary_rationale: Afcom Holdings has executed a rapid operational breakout since its December 2024 DGCA AOC, scaling revenue from ₹148.19 Cr in FY24 to ₹583.00 Cr in FY26 and ₹417.00 Cr in H1 FY27 while sustaining 37%–40% EBITDA margins via dry-leased Boeing 737-800BCFs and Designated Indian Carrier ATF VAT exemptions. H1 FY27 delivered an encouraging working-capital inflection (trade receivables stabilized at ₹134.52 Cr vs ₹135.76 Cr in FY26; H1 CFO rose to ₹49.47 Cr, or 55% of PAT vs 29.5% in FY26). However, persistent heavy investing outflows (-₹214.46 Cr in H1 FY27; FCF -₹164.99 Cr), thin unrestricted operating cash (just ₹5.15 Cr outside ₹87.16 Cr restricted QIP monitoring funds), 4th/5th narrowbody induction lag (zero QIP customs/insurance spend by Sep 30), Ind AS 116 lease liabilities (~₹338 Cr in FY26; ₹398 Cr total borrowings at Sep 2026), co-founder Jaganmohan Manthena's Nov 12, 2026 board/committee exit, promoter-group open-market disposals, >58% cyclical charter reliance, and direct main-deck competition from IndiGo CarGo's three 27-tonne A321P2F freighters keep the franchise firmly in CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL with PASS_WITH_WATCH.
